description: This file defines React context and provider components for the Keystone admin UI, including functions for accessing and managing lists, fields, and the keystone context. It also handles data fetching via GraphQL queries and integrates with Apollo Client.

methods.name: InternalKeystoneProvider
methods.description: Main React component providing the Keystone context, managing data fetching, global styles, and rendering children within the context.

methods.name: KeystoneProvider
methods.description: Sets up Apollo Client and wraps the internal provider to supply context to the app.

methods.name: useKeystone
methods.description: Custom hook to access Keystone context.

methods.name: useList
methods.description: Custom hook to access a specific list's metadata and fields.

methods.name: useField
methods.description: Custom hook to access a specific field in a list.

methods.name: useListItem
methods.description: Custom hook to fetch an individual list item based on list key and item ID.
